invariants.expression: result == style.imageDisabled || result == style.imageCheckedDown || result == style.imageDown || result == style.imageCheckedOver || result == style.imageOver || result == style.imageChecked || result == style.imageUp
invariants.rationale: The method returns one of these fields from 'style' only, as seen in the control flow.
The method always returns a non-null Drawable because all style fields are checked for null before returning; the final fallback (style.imageUp) is always returned, assumed non-null.
If the result is imageDisabled, it must be because isDisabled() and style.imageDisabled != null.

invariants.expression: result == style.imageCheckedDown ? (isPressed() && isChecked() && style.imageCheckedDown != null) : true
invariants.rationale: If the result is imageCheckedDown, it must be because isPressed(), isChecked(), and style.imageCheckedDown != null.

invariants.expression: result == style.imageUp ? (!isDisabled() && !isPressed() && !isOver() && (!isChecked() || style.imageChecked == null && !(isOver() && style.imageOver != null))) : true
invariants.rationale: The only way imageUp is returned is if none of the other conditional returns are true.
